verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a CLI-driven static site generator. Its documented CLI and `npm run build` produce static files in a `build` directory with no interactive step, and the output deploys to static hosts like GitHub Pages, Netlify and Vercel. Community reports confirm builds running on GitHub Actions runners, though large sites can be slow or time out there. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of CI workflows or non-interactive flags, and evidence of reliable CI performance on large sites (one report cites builds over 30 minutes timing out on GitHub Actions).
